title: Duodenal biopsy - simple canned report v1 (Marsh-aware)

villous_architecture.description: Overall villous architecture. Map phrases: 'normal/retained villi'->Retained; 'blunted/shortened villi'->Blunted; 'subtotal villous atrophy'->Subtotal; 'total villous atrophy/flat'->Total.

iel_status.description: Intraepithelial lymphocytes. Map: 'no increase/within normal'->No increase; 'focal/focally increased IEL'->Focally increased; 'increased IEL/raised IEL'->Increased.

crypt_hyperplasia.description: Crypt hyperplasia. Map phrases: 'crypt hyperplasia present'->Present; otherwise Not identified.

gastric_metaplasia.description: Gastric foveolar metaplasia. Map: 'focal gastric metaplasia/foveolar metaplasia'->Focal; 'widespread/diffuse gastric metaplasia'->Widespread.

marsh_classification.description: If the text explicitly states a Marsh grade, use it. Otherwise infer from features: Marsh 0 = normal villi + no increase IEL; Marsh 1 = increased IEL with retained villi; Marsh 2 = Marsh 1 + crypt hyperplasia; Marsh 3a = partial villous atrophy/blunting with crypt hyperplasia + increased IEL; Marsh 3b = subtotal villous atrophy with crypt hyperplasia + increased IEL; Marsh 3c = total villous atrophy/flat mucosa with crypt hyperplasia + increased IEL.

comment_line.description: Optional free-text comment line to append to the conclusion.
